metadata.source: Geometry: EA (England) + NRW (Wales) + SEPA (Scotland) WFD TraC water bodies (OGL). Category: MSN 1837 (as amended), MCA.
metadata.coverage: UK-wide: all major England/Wales/Scotland estuaries, firths & named sea lochs + outer Cat D approaches. Outside these polygons: not classified.
metadata.caveat: All three nations are mapped per-body from MSN 1837 Annex 1 (England from the EA list; Wales from the NRW list; Scotland from the SEPA list), each feature carrying its msn_reference and a confidence grade. Internal A/B/C/D sub-zoning within a body and exact seaward limits remain approximate — verify against MSN 1837 Annex 1 and MCA TSN. msn-limit-lines.geojson holds indicative closing lines for the largest estuaries.
